Dinner carried 64.4% of net, lunch 26.3%, espresso service 9.2% at $265.25.

The schedule has been cut hard off the weekend (13 -> 11 -> 6 -> 8) which is the right response to Sunday's 39.8% labor ratio, but single-cook coverage on a night with a confirmed 10-top is the exposure to watch.

6. TONIGHT -- 10-TOP BIRTHDAY, 7:00 PM. Rich Davis, 10 guests, confirmed via SpotHopper, (805) 680-6405, birthday dinner. Make sure the kitchen knows and that whoever is cooking has support at 7.

7. ADS. Two Google Ads report emails in the last 24h (Campaign performance, Brewhouse Daily Campaign Report), account 343-687-4835. No disapprovals, no budget alerts.
